## Commercial usage for real projects

One NA-AI Landing purchase permits unlimited personal, commercial, and client end products under the PyColors Standard Commercial License. You may customize and deploy the template; you may not redistribute the template itself.

The template is designed for:

- personal projects
- commercial products
- SaaS marketing pages
- AI product launches
- agency delivery
- client work
- startup validation

## License scope

The included Standard Commercial License permits unlimited end products without per-seat restrictions. It is not a single-project license.

- You may build and deploy personal, commercial, and client projects.
- Employees, contractors, freelancers, and collaborators may access the template while working on the same final project.
- That collaboration does not grant standalone access for unrelated projects.
- Clients may use the final deployed project. Extracting, redistributing, reselling, or reusing the template for unrelated projects requires their own license and remains subject to its restrictions.
- Do not publish the source package, sell it as a template or development kit, or use its source, assets, or documentation to train AI models or code generators.

Keep the `LICENSE` file delivered with your purchase and any specific written order agreement. A later website summary does not automatically reduce rights granted with an earlier purchase. Mandatory consumer rights remain applicable.

<Callout type="info" title="Your project and the template source">
  You retain your rights in the original code, content, and branding you create.
  The underlying template and its third-party components keep their respective
  licenses.
</Callout>

## What the license does not include

NA-AI Landing does not include:

- backend implementation
- authentication
- database foundations
- Stripe billing
- CMS integration
- email infrastructure
- custom implementation work
- guaranteed third-party service configuration

If you need:

- authentication
- billing
- protected routes
- backend-ready SaaS foundations

review Starter Pro.

<Callout title="Product boundary">
  NA-AI Landing is the frontend marketing layer. It is not a complete SaaS
  application.
</Callout>

### Updates and support

The purchase includes the delivered version. Future template updates, fixes, and features may be provided at PyColors’ discretion unless your written offer includes additional rights. This does not exclude mandatory conformity or security-update obligations.

There is no guaranteed release schedule or response time. For missing access or a billing issue, use [purchase support](/orders/support). For withdrawal, refunds, and consumer guarantees, see the [Terms of Service](/terms#terms-delivery-refunds).

### Support scope

Reasonable-effort support focuses on:

- package access
- installation questions
- setup clarification
- documentation clarification
- delivered source code issues

Support generally does not include:

- building custom backends
- rewriting the design for your brand
- integrating third-party services for you
- creating custom features
- debugging unrelated infrastructure

### Versioning policy

NA-AI Landing follows Semantic Versioning.

For complete rules and upgrade expectations, see the shared [Versioning policy](/docs/project/versioning-policy).

<Callout title="Versioning principle">
  Semantic Versioning helps keep updates predictable as the template evolves.
</Callout>

## Common questions

<Accordions type="single">
  <Accordion title="Can I use NA-AI Landing for client work?">
    Yes. The included Standard Commercial License permits unlimited client end products. Clients may use the deployed project; standalone template access or reuse for unrelated projects requires their own license.
  </Accordion>

<Accordion title="Can I resell the template after modifying it?">
  No. You cannot resell, redistribute, sublicense, or publish the source code as
  a competing template.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Can I connect it to my backend?">
  Yes. You can connect the frontend to your own backend, CMS, analytics, form
  provider, or payment flow.
</Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Does the template include Stripe payments?">
    No. NA-AI Landing is frontend-only. Use Starter Pro if you need billing foundations.
  </Accordion>
</Accordions>

## Practical usage examples

Examples permitted by the Standard Commercial License:

- launching your SaaS marketing site
- building a startup landing page
- shipping a client website
- adapting the visuals and branding
- integrating APIs and analytics
- deploying the final website publicly

Examples that are generally not allowed:

- selling the template source code
- republishing the ZIP package
- distributing the source publicly
- turning the source into a competing template business

<Callout title="Ship the project, not the source as a product.">
  The license is designed to help you build real products while protecting the
  template from redistribution.
</Callout>
